machines.label: Machines
machines.blurb: CNC machines and automation equipment designed and assembled by QS — with local warranty and technical support in Vietnam.

controllers.label: Controllers
controllers.blurb: QS Technology offers a broad range of controllers that flexibly cover requirements for axis count, control method and application scale across CNC machines, robots and industrial automation systems. They support the common communication standards — Pulse Train, EtherCAT and Mechatrolink — so they connect to a wide range of servo drives and peripheral devices.

servo.label: QS servo
servo.blurb: QS Servo delivers the precise motion control that CNC machines and industrial automation systems require. The line covers servo drives, servo motors and connection cables, so each configuration can be matched to the machine type and the application. Fast response and high accuracy in position and speed control keep the system stable, synchronised and more efficient.

inverter.label: Inverters
inverter.blurb: SAVCH inverters cover a wide range of motor control requirements in CNC machines, industrial machinery and automation systems. They allow flexible speed and frequency adjustment along with torque control matched to the load characteristics and operating requirements of each application.

dnc.label: DNC Transfer Units
dnc.blurb: DNC transfer units load machining programs from USB or Wi-Fi and feed them to the CNC machine over RS232. Continuous data transfer handles large programs even when the CNC machine's own memory is limited. The units run standalone, making programs easy to store and manage on the shop floor.

accessory.label: Accessories
accessory.blurb: QS Technology supplies a wide range of CNC support accessories, including expansion boards, signal converters, connection cables and measurement devices. These products extend connectivity, handle signal processing and verify parameters during machine installation, operation and upgrades.
